# 06 Live Notes

## Goal

A user can write private notes during a live recording, have them autosaved, and keep them attached to the meeting after finalization.

## Why This Comes Now

Durable live audio establishes that the recording session can survive instability. Notes are the first user-authored artifact layered onto the session and must prove autosave and preservation before generated live insights or task reconciliation add more mutable state.

## Included Scope

- Show a private notes surface during live recording.
- Autosave note edits while the recording is active.
- Preserve notes across refresh and finalization.
- Keep notes separate from generated transcript and synthesis output.
- Display notes in the finalized meeting review surface.

## Not Included

- Collaborative notes, shared visibility controls, or rich-text editing.
- Generated talking points, task extraction, or speaker assignment.
- Using notes as ML prompt context for final synthesis.
- Export or external sync of notes.

No ML slice for this milestone.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Core | `PATCH /meetings/{id}` notes field update; debounced write semantics; `EntityChangedEvent { entity: "meeting" }` broadcast | `./dev new slice meeting-recording 06-live-notes core live-notes` | S | Milestone 03 merged (shared note components) |
| 2 | App | Notes textarea autosave in the recording view (debounced `PATCH`); restore on refresh; display in finalized meeting detail via M03 shared note components | `./dev new slice meeting-recording 06-live-notes app live-notes-editor` | S | Slice 1 merged |

## Acceptance

These criteria map to `tests/bets/meeting-recording/test_milestone_06_live_notes.py`. Run via `./dev test bet meeting-recording`.

- [ ] User can create and edit private notes while recording is active.
- [ ] Notes autosave without requiring a manual save action.
- [ ] Refreshing during recording restores the latest saved note content.
- [ ] Stopping and finalizing the meeting preserves the notes unchanged.
- [ ] Final generated artifacts do not overwrite user-authored notes.
- [ ] Note save failure is visible and does not corrupt existing saved content.
